elements.quote: While this systematic review was conducted with care, it is not without limitations. ... The results are based on a relatively small number of studies for most outcomes. This is mostly due to our restriction to only include studies with a robust study design (eg, CBA or ITS studies). ... there is still a potential for publication bias.

elements.quote: The certainty of evidence is very low for mortality (in- hospital; 30 days) and low for complications, reoperations, length of stay and travel distance. ... Thus, reported outcomes should be interpreted with caution.
